title: Recognise the Quadratic
text:
This is a quadratic equation in sin x. Let y = sin x:
$$2y^2 - y - 1 = 0$$

We can factorise or use the quadratic formula.

title: Factorise
text:
Factorise 2y² - y - 1:
- Find factors of 2 × (-1) = -2 that add to -1
- These are -2 and +1
- So: 2y² - 2y + y - 1 = 2y(y-1) + 1(y-1) = (2y+1)(y-1)

$$(2y + 1)(y - 1) = 0$$

title: Solve for sin x
text:
From (2y + 1)(y - 1) = 0:
- 2y + 1 = 0 gives y = -1/2, so sin x = -1/2
- y - 1 = 0 gives y = 1, so sin x = 1
